payload.session: uuid — the session the scene is added to; its rank is the session's last + 1 (scene-order-contiguous), settled when it is applied
payload.title: string — the scene's title, not blank
payload.notes: string | null — optional, the DM's notes on the scene
payload.places: uuid[] — optional, the places the scene links, in order, each an element of the session's campaign (scene-links-same-campaign); their media are the session's through session_media_view, never stored (session-media-by-place)
